instruction: Adjust the title alignment on slide 3 so that it is centered.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the text alignment of the title on slide 3 (index 2) to center. Slide 3 contains 'Hello there!' as the main text. The evaluator checks if at least one text shape has CENTER alignment.
metadata.verification: Verified by analyzing presentation. Slide 3 (index 2) has text 'Hello there!' and other content. Task requires changing alignment to center.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly identifies the title shape using placeholder_format.type == 1 (standard PowerPoint title placeholder)
Fallback to first text shape is a reasonable heuristic for cases where placeholder type is not available
Metric properly verifies that title_found == True before checking alignment, preventing false positives from missing titles
Evaluator specifically targets the title shape alignment, not all shapes indiscriminately
Expected value 'CENTER' is semantically correct for the task requirement
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) to ensure changes are persisted before verification
Complete coverage: All requirements verified (slide 3, title shape, center alignment)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Could add more robust error handling for edge cases where text_frame or paragraphs are empty, though current implementation handles basic cases adequately
